The One Prime rule is a rule in [[Lifeism]] that all things should be organized into powers of three for better organization. This led to the increase of the [[seven Plagues]] to the [[Nine Plagues]] and the deprecation of the doctrine of the [[Five Ancestors]].

In a more general sense the looser version of it was responsible for the temporary dropping of a lot of work on more general mythology in 2021 in favor of more work on mysticism instead.
